title: fix(cli): the CLI opens a sign-in page only for an http(s) address, and never through a shell
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:命令行登录时只会为 http 或 https 的登录地址自动打开浏览器,其它地址只打印出来;在 Windows 上连接 Claude Code 时,若找到的是 npm 安装的批处理包装而非程序本体,命令会停下并提示用户自己运行那一行。
- 为什么做:命令行工具启动外部程序一律不经过系统外壳,属于安全加固,由安全席位派发。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是浏览器没有自动打开或 Windows 上没有自动登记,用户照屏幕上的地址或命令手动完成即可;整单可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

The rule: **the CLI opens a sign-in page only for an http(s) address, and never through a shell; every program the CLI starts on behalf of the sign-in and `os mcp connect` paths starts from an argv array with `shell: false`.**

- `packages/cli/src/utils/open-browser.ts` (new) is the one browser opener. It parses the address with `new URL`, opens only `http:`/`https:`, hands the parser's `href` to the platform opener as one argv element (`open` on macOS, `xdg-open` elsewhere, `rundll32.exe url.dll,FileProtocolHandler` by its absolute path under `%SystemRoot%\System32` on Windows; `start` is a `cmd.exe` builtin and needs a shell, so it is not used), and answers whether it started one.
- `os login` (`commands/login.ts`) and `os cloud login` (`utils/auth-flows.ts`) both use it; the two private copies are deleted. "Browser opened automatically" is printed only when an opener was started; otherwise a line says the address was not opened and the printed address is the fallback.
- `os mcp connect` (`commands/mcp/connect.ts`) starts `claude` with `shell: false` on every platform. `resolveClientExecutable` answers which file that is: off Windows the bare name; on Windows the file `cmd.exe` would have run for the name (first absolute `PATH` entry holding `claude.com`/`.exe`/`.bat`/`.cmd`, in that order per entry; the current directory and relative entries are not searched), and an `.exe`/`.com` runs by its absolute path. A `.cmd`/`.bat` shim cannot be started without a shell, so it is not run: the command exits 1 saying so, and the printed `claude mcp add` line is the fallback. `mcpClientRunner.run` is now only `spawnSync(command, args, { stdio: 'inherit', shell: false })`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/test/sign-in-page-opens-http-only-without-a-shell.test.ts` — `node:child_process` mocked. Both device flows × darwin / linux / win32 × a plain and a punctuated https address: the opener is `spawn(command, [..., href], { shell: false })`, `exec`/`execSync` never called. Five non-http(s) addresses: nothing launched, the address printed, no "opened" line. `os mcp connect`: on win32 `claude.exe` resolves to its absolute path and runs with `shell: false`; a shim is answered `batch-shim`; the current directory and relative entries are not searched; darwin/linux run `claude` by name with `shell: false`; the per-entry lookup order.
- `packages/cli/test/cli-launches-without-a-shell.pin.test.ts` — a TypeScript-AST source pin over every `.ts` under `packages/cli/src`: no `child_process` `exec`/`execSync` whose command is not one plain string literal, and no `shell` option other than literal `false` in a file that loads `child_process`, beyond four named, measured allowances (below). It also reds on an allowance nothing needs any more, and carries a detector self-test (10 spellings that must be found, 9 that must not).

## Acceptance notes

- **Allow-listed in the source pin, measured, not changed here** (none carries text the CLI did not write or validate to a fixed character set): `commands/doctor.ts` `probeTool` (constant probes `pnpm -v`, `tsc -v`, `git --version`, through the shell on purpose); `commands/dev.ts` `pnpm [--filter PACKAGE --fail-if-no-match] dev` (PACKAGE is the user's own positional argument); `commands/init.ts` `PM install` (closed set npm/pnpm/yarn/bun); `utils/skills-catalog.ts` `npm pack` on Windows (shim needs a shell; exact-version charset and a quoted CLI-created directory).
- **Windows narrowing for `os mcp connect`:** a user whose `claude` resolves to an npm `claude.cmd` shim now gets a non-zero exit and the line to run. Not measured on a Windows host; the lookup and the no-shell launch are pinned with a mocked file system and a mocked `spawnSync`.
- The `rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler` choice is not measured on a Windows host either; it is pinned as the argv the opener receives.
